description: Queries an Epic FHIR server using OAuth 2.0 JWT-bearer authentication and pushes each returned resource downstream as JSON.

config.label: Interval
config.description: How often, in milliseconds, the runtime invokes the polling script.

config.label: Base URL
config.description: Root URL of the Epic Interconnect FHIR endpoint. The token endpoint and /api/FHIR paths are appended to it, so a trailing slash is expected (one is added if omitted).

config.label: Client ID
config.description: The non-production or production client ID assigned when the app was registered on the Epic App Orchard / open.epic.

config.label: Private Key Path
config.description: Absolute path to the PEM-encoded RSA private key whose public key is registered with Epic. Used to sign the RS384 JWT client assertion; it is read at authentication time and never copied into the node config.

config.label: FHIR Version
config.description: FHIR release to target. Becomes the version segment of /api/FHIR/<version>/.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: FHIR resource type to search on each poll, for example Patient, Encounter or Observation.

config.label: Search Query
config.description: Search parameters as a URL query string, for example family=Smith&birthdate=1970-01-01. Leave empty to search without filters. Epic requires at least one identifying parameter for most resource types.

config.label: Live Mode
config.description: When off, FHIR requests are simulated and no data leaves the runtime, which is useful while wiring up a workflow. Authentication is always performed live so credential problems surface immediately.

config.label: Verify TLS
config.description: Whether to verify the Epic server's TLS certificate. Leave on outside of local testing against a proxy.
